description: Figure 7 compares different query selection strategies. The x-axis represents the query selection strategies, with the values 1, 2, 3, and 4. The y-axis represents the probability of finding a query similar to the user input query, with the values ranging from 0 to 1. The solid lines represent the well-trained DPR retrievers with corpus expansion, while the dotted lines represent the typical representation. The lines with the same color are results for the same DPR. The solid red line in Figure 7 shows that the retrieval latency also increases linearly with the increase of S. The dotted lines in the figure represent the retrieval performance of the proposed curriculum sampling improve with the increase of S.
